name: glassdoor/reviews
description: Get employee reviews for a company on Glassdoor by company ID, with rating, pros, cons, job title, date and sub-ratings.

q.description: Parameter defines the text to search for in the reviews, like the review search box of Glassdoor (e.g., `work life balance` or `remote`).

num.description: Parameter defines the number of reviews per page, from `1` to `100`. It defaults to `10`, like on Glassdoor.

page.description: Parameter defines the page number of the reviews (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of reviews, `2` is the 2nd page of reviews, etc.).

rating.description: Parameter defines the overall rating of the reviews, from `1` to `5` stars. Searches with `q` return the reviews rated `rating` or higher (e.g., `4` for 4 and 5 stars).

sort_by.description: Parameter defines the sorting order of the reviews. It defaults to `most_relevant`. Available options: `most_relevant` - Most relevant `newest` - Newest `oldest` - Oldest `highest_rating` - Highest rating `lowest_rating` - Lowest rating

language.description: Parameter defines the language of the reviews. It defaults to `en` (English). Glassdoor's search of `q` only covers English reviews, so the language doesn't apply to searches with `q`. Available options: `en` - English `fr` - French `de` - German `es` - Spanish `pt` - Portuguese `it` - Italian `nl` - Dutch

location.description: Parameter defines the location of the reviewers' jobs: a city, state or country (e.g., `New York, NY`, `California`, or `India`). We use the first location Glassdoor suggests with that name, or else its first suggestion.

job_title.description: Parameter defines the job title of the reviewers (e.g., `Software Engineer`).

employer_id.description: Parameter defines the Glassdoor ID of the company (e.g., `9079` for Google). It is the number after `E` in Glassdoor company URLs (e.g., https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Google-Reviews-E9079.htm), and the `employer_id` of our Glassdoor Companies API results.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

current_employees.description: Parameter defines whether to only show the reviews of current employees. It can be set to `true` or `false` (default).

employment_status.description: Parameter defines the employment status of the reviewers. Separate several statuses with a comma (e.g., `intern,contract`). It defaults to `full_time,part_time`. Available options: `full_time` - Full-time `part_time` - Part-time `contract` - Contract `intern` - Intern `freelance` - Freelance

# Glassdoor Reviews

Get employee reviews for a company on Glassdoor by company ID, with rating, pros, cons, job title, date and sub-ratings.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/glassdoor/reviews" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"employer_id": "7633"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `employer_id` | string | Yes | Parameter defines the Glassdoor ID of the company (e.g., `9079` for Google). It is the number after `E` in Glassdoor company URLs (e.g., https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Google-Reviews-E9079.htm), and the `employer_id` of our Glassdoor Com |
| `location` | string | No | Parameter defines the location of the reviewers' jobs: a city, state or country (e.g., `New York, NY`, `California`, or `India`). We use the first location Glassdoor suggests with that name, or else its first suggestion. |
| `language` | string | No | Parameter defines the language of the reviews. It defaults to `en` (English). Glassdoor's search of `q` only covers English reviews, so the language doesn't apply to searches with `q`. Available options: `en` - English `fr` - French `de` -  |
| `q` | string | No | Parameter defines the text to search for in the reviews, like the review search box of Glassdoor (e.g., `work life balance` or `remote`). |
| `sort_by` | string | No | Parameter defines the sorting order of the reviews. It defaults to `most_relevant`. Available options: `most_relevant` - Most relevant `newest` - Newest `oldest` - Oldest `highest_rating` - Highest rating `lowest_rating` - Lowest rating |
| `rating` | string | No | Parameter defines the overall rating of the reviews, from `1` to `5` stars. Searches with `q` return the reviews rated `rating` or higher (e.g., `4` for 4 and 5 stars). |
| `employment_status` | string | No | Parameter defines the employment status of the reviewers. Separate several statuses with a comma (e.g., `intern,contract`). It defaults to `full_time,part_time`. Available options: `full_time` - Full-time `part_time` - Part-time `contract`  |
| `current_employees` | string | No | Parameter defines whether to only show the reviews of current employees. It can be set to `true` or `false` (default). |
| `job_title` | string | No | Parameter defines the job title of the reviewers (e.g., `Software Engineer`). |
| `page` | string | No | Parameter defines the page number of the reviews (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of reviews, `2` is the 2nd page of reviews, etc.). |
| `num` | string | No | Parameter defines the number of reviews per page, from `1` to `100`. It defaults to `10`, like on Glassdoor. |
| `json_restrictor` | string | No | Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details. |

## Pricing

$0.010 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
